name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a Qiskit program testing the 3-qub
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a Qiskit program testing the 3-qubit Mermin inequality on a GHZ state: estimate <XXX>, <XYY>, <YXY>, <YYX> with StatevectorEstimator and show M = <XXX> - <XYY> - <YXY> - <YYX> reaches 4 (classical bound 2). The code must be a complete standalone script that can be executed directly and produces output.
